scenarios.name: test-roar-first
scenarios.why: Generated by cmd/xmageport from XMage EmbiggenTest#testRoarFirst.
scenarios.known_bug: XP[targeted-alltypes-count-unmodelled]: Embiggen's X:Targeted$AllTypes (+1/+1 for each supertype, card type and subtype of the target) is not a Count head the evaluator models (no AllTypes reader in effects/EvalCount), so X is 0 and the pump adds nothing: Embiggen alone on Blighted Agent leaves it 1/1 (want 5/5) and after Relic's Roar it stays 4/3 (want 10/9), CR 205.1, 608.2h, verified at gorge c3b957bf36.
